code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, neutropenia, and elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, ferritin, D-dimer). There is also mild hyperkalemia, hyperchloremia, and a slightly elevated INR. These findings suggest a systemic inflammatory response, possible infection or hypoxic injury, and a risk of coagulopathy. Clinical correlation and further evaluation for underlying causes (e.g., infection, hypoxia, or inflammatory disease) are recommended.
